title: 第171章 颜晨宴的净利润
slug: 让我开早餐店我下午才营业
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

几个化着淡妆，穿着清凉常服的年轻女孩走了进来。

走在最前面的，正是昨天在谢记水汇给范理按背的8号技师。

“范老板，生意真好啊。”8号技师笑眯眯地走上前。

范理抬头看了一眼笑道，“随便坐。想吃点什么？”

跟在8号后面的三个女孩好奇地打量着这家店。

“谢总天天在店里吹，说这味道天上地下独一份，闻着这味道我都饿了。”

8号转头看向菜单，十分干脆说道，“老板，两份清汤面，一笼灌汤小笼包，四份甜豆花。豆花上快点啊，饿扁了。”

不一会儿，舒书麻利地端上四碗甜豆花放在她们桌上。

白玉般的豆花浸在透明的糖浆里。

其中一个短发女孩拿起小勺，舀起一勺豆花，送进嘴里。

上下牙齿甚至没来得及闭合。

豆花顺着舌尖直接滑入喉咙。紧接着，极其纯正的黄豆清香在口腔里传来，夹杂着糖浆清透不腻的甘甜，瞬间洗刷了熬夜加班带来的疲惫感。

短发女孩眼睛猛地瞪大，张了张嘴，半天没吐出一个字，随即低头开始疯狂往嘴里扒拉豆花。

其他三个女孩见状，将信将疑地吃了一口。

两秒后，这桌彻底安静。只剩下勺子磕碰瓷碗的清脆声响。

“太滑了吧！怎么做到的？”

“好甜，但不腻口，好吃！”

不到一分钟，四碗甜豆花连糖水都被喝得干干净净。

舒书端着蒸笼和两碗面走过来，放在桌上，“小笼包和清汤面。小心烫。”

蒸笼盖一掀。

白蒙蒙的热气升腾，麦香混合着黑猪肉的霸道脂香瞬间笼罩了这方小天地。

8号技师夹起一个小笼包，学着隔壁桌刘业的动作，先咬破面皮吸了一口汤。

滚烫鲜美的汤汁一入口，她浑身一颤。

鲜！极致的鲜！肉香没有一丝杂质。手工揉制的面皮韧性十足，和昨天给范理按摩时那硬邦邦的肉截然不同，这面皮软弹得像在舌尖跳舞。

“呜呜呜好吃……”短发女孩正大口唆着清汤面。金华火腿和老母鸡熬制的高汤鲜得她差点把舌头吞下去。

“我算明白谢总为什么为了吃口热饭非要在这开水汇了。”8号技师咽下肉馅说道。

Page (1/3)

Several young girls wearing light makeup and cool casual clothes walked in.

The one at the front was Technician No. 8 who massaged Fan Li's back at Xie Ji Shui Hui yesterday.

"Boss Fan, business is so good." Technician No. 8 walked forward with a smile.

Fan Li looked up and said with a smile, "Sit anywhere. What do you want to eat?"

The three girls following No. 8 looked at the store curiously.

“Mr.

No. 8 turned to look at the menu and said very simply, "Boss, two portions of clear soup noodles, one cage of soup dumplings, and four portions of sweet tofu pudding. Hurry on the tofu pudding, I'm hungry."

After a while, Shu Shu quickly brought four bowls of sweet tofu and placed them on their table.

White jade-like bean curds are soaked in transparent syrup.

One of the short-haired girls picked up a small spoon, scooped up a spoonful of beancurd, and put it into her mouth.

The upper and lower teeth didn't even have time to close.

The bean curd slides directly into the throat along the tip of the tongue.Immediately afterwards, the extremely pure fragrance of soybeans spread in the mouth, mixed with the clear and not greasy sweetness of syrup, instantly washing away the fatigue caused by staying up late and working overtime.

The short-haired girl's eyes suddenly widened and she opened her mouth. She didn't say a word for a long time, then she lowered her head and started to frantically shovel the tofu into her mouth.

The other three girls saw this and took a bite with suspicion.

Two seconds later, the table was completely silent.The only sound left was the crisp sound of the spoon hitting the porcelain bowl.

"It's too slippery! How did you do it?"

“So sweet, but not cloying, delicious!”

In less than a minute, all four bowls of sweet tofu pudding and sugar water were drank.

Shu Shu came over with a steamer basket and two bowls of noodles and placed them on the table, "Xiaolongbao and clear soup noodles. Be careful to burn them."

Lift the steamer lid.

The white heat rises, and the overbearing fat aroma of wheat mixed with black pork instantly envelopes this small world.

Technician No. 8 picked up a small steamed bun and imitated Liu Ye’s actions at the table next door, biting through the dough and taking a sip of the soup.

As soon as the hot and delicious soup entered her mouth, she trembled all over.

fresh!Extremely fresh!The meaty aroma has no trace of impurities.The hand-kneaded dough is very tough, which is completely different from the hard meat when she massaged Fan Li yesterday. This dough is so soft and elastic that it feels like dancing on the tip of the tongue.

"Woooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo delicious, short-haired girl.The broth made from Jinhua ham and old hens was so delicious that she almost swallowed it.

"I understand why Mr. Xie had to boil water here in order to have a hot meal." Technician No. 8 said after swallowing the minced meat.
